suitability_reason: Premium tax credit eligibility and full APTC repayment follow mechanically from MAGI ($91,274 AGI + $3,975 nontaxable Social Security) vs 400% of FPL ($15,930 two-person); cancellation claim rejected on evidence.

taxpayer.notes: Unemployed since April 2015; claimed dependency exemption for her son; household size two.

adjustments: required Form 8962 reconciliation of APTC payments totaling $7,205
on the basis of MAGI, petitioner not eligible for PTC and must repay APTC in full
notice_of_deficiency.contested_by_taxpayer: Says she canceled her coverage in February 2016 so no APTC should have been paid on her behalf.

findings_of_fact.fact: Enrolled in Florida Blue Marketplace coverage for first 11 months of 2016; monthly premium $708, total $7,788
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioner’s monthly premium for her Florida Blue coverage was $708, for a total of $7,788 for the 11 months.

findings_of_fact.fact: Monthly APTC payments of $655 for 11 months, total $7,205, paid to Florida Blue
findings_of_fact.snippet: she received the benefit of monthly APTC payments of $655, fo r a total of $7,205.

findings_of_fact.fact: No Marketplace record of a termination request; coverage terminated November 30, 2016 for nonpayment
findings_of_fact.snippet: on November 30, 2016, her coverage was terminated for nonpayment of premiums.

findings_of_fact.fact: 2016 return: HOH, exemption for self and son; AGI $91,274 = taxable pensions/annuities $68,750 + taxable Social Security $22,524; total Social Security $26,499
findings_of_fact.snippet: total income (and adjusted gross income (AGI)) of $91,274, consisting of taxable pensions and annuities of $68,750 and taxable Social Security benefits of $22,524

findings_of_fact.fact: Itemized deductions $28,751; withholding $13,750; claimed refund $5,846; no Form 8962 attached
findings_of_fact.snippet: petitioner claimed itemized deductions of $28,751 and reported income tax withholding from the pensions and annuities of $13,750, for a claimed refund of $5,846.

findings_of_fact.fact: MAGI = AGI $91,274 + nontaxable Social Security $3,975 = $95,249; household income equals MAGI (son had no reported income)
findings_of_fact.snippet: for purposes of section 36B, her MAGI for 2016 was $95, 249

findings_of_fact.fact: FPL for two-person household in Florida for 2016 (Jan. 22, 2015 guidelines) was $15,930
findings_of_fact.snippet: the FPL for a two -person household in Florida during 2016 was $15,930.

findings_of_fact.fact: Household income was 598% of FPL (rounded), exceeding 400%
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioner’s household income of $95,249 was 598% 5 of the FPL during 2016

issues.question: (Premium tax credit, §36B) Was petitioner entitled to the PTC for 2016, and if not must she repay the $7,205 of APTC payments?
issues.holding: Not entitled; household income of $95,249 was 598% of FPL (>400%), so no PTC and no repayment cap; tax increased by full $7,205 APTC. Claim of February 2016 cancellation unsupported.
issues.computable_reason: MAGI/FPL ratio > 400% mechanically eliminates PTC and repayment limit; APTC total stipulated.

decision.text: Decision will be entered for respondent.

notes: Facts stipulated/deemed stipulated. Corrected Form 1095-A showed coverage Jan 1 - Nov 30, 2016. Petitioner paid remaining $53 of some premiums. Derived: 400% of $15,930 = $63,720 (derived). Court directed respondent to include alternative payment possibilities in correspondence (fn 6).
